body:
Adds one reconstructed horse in the 1835 Western Hotel wagon yard, using a licensed textured development model and a gentle source-derived head/tail idle. The individual, breed and owner remain unidentified. Full/Balanced load it lazily; Light keeps no horse model or idle player. A bounded retained yard-support cache permits grounding after coarse-device CPU geometry release. The original model and attribution are preserved.

The selection card identifies the horse as reconstructed and keeps the modern 2021 author/license credit outside historical confidence grades, retaining citations and research credit. No model, idle, placement, support or non-card consumer behavior changed during the card repair/integration.

Validation at pushed `a47401a24950ec2d6cd652e4badad89533a1fc16`, tree `c9e0b41b746de967d73765633702dac748178d63`:

- Canonical resolver passed all 200 producers, seven second-pass producers and the settled downstream tail. Normal publication/mirror and exact protected horse/runtime/person source checks passed. An earlier environment-interrupted resolver is preserved as interrupted, not successful.
- Full preflight passed **1,050 checks, including 381 self-tests**, with required readers and unchanged source. Global terminal logs were immediately preserved.
- Actual-commit changelog/ID/whitespace checks and postcommit publication/mirror passed. The branch is clean and the remote HEAD is verified.
- The focused own-card regression passes against the actual card helper/popup lead, with controls for the former false historical attestation and a missing modern citation.

**Dependency and tested base:** this normal merge includes still-unmerged person PR #1175 through its actual test-merge `8fc3fd3f0` (parents `8f5127d4` and DEV `7d9afc0e`). Both 1835 actor layers, their separate mixers/ground callbacks and the horse support region are preserved. The latest Wheeler DEV changes (`73aef…`) and subsequent person head are not included in this tested tree. Keep this PR draft and do not merge it before #1175 lands; current live-DEV integration/CI remains separate.

Earlier browser evidence remains labeled `fde6bc317`; protected model/idle/placement/support and non-card runtime bytes remain unchanged:

- The unchanged original mobile yard caller passed head/tail movement, zero drift of four annotated hoof patches, reduced-motion/confidence-hidden pause, coarse array release, selection and disposal. Three images were reviewed; the quarter view is partly occluded by the real fence. That run exposed the card defect repaired here.
- Desktop model/framing/budget/finite-contact checks passed. Both original desktop 15-wall-second/1.5-owned-second timing checks **failed** and remain failed. Exact source-clock accounting was confirmed under three slow software-rendered frames; independent review identifies the timing bound as a private caller heuristic. Later desktop product checks were not completed. No desktop performance qualification is claimed.

Current published **mobile** verification at `a47401a24` passed in 160.54 seconds using the original caller, cameras, deadlines and thresholds. The original 15-second/1.5-owned-second timing check passed; actual weighted head/tail vertices moved while all four annotated hoof patches had exactly zero drift. Reduced-motion/confidence-hidden pause, clone/source isolation, coarse array release and bounded grounding, actual layer pick plus production popup, and geometry/material/mixer disposal passed with zero browser errors. The real card shows the reconstructed lead, exact modern 2021 credit and attested 0 of 4. All four PNGs were reviewed; the fixed quarter camera retains real fence occlusion. Browser/server cleanup completed with no active owned process. This is software-rendered viewport evidence, not phone hardware performance or OS pointer/occlusion coverage.

Current published **desktop** verification at `a47401a24` ended **FAIL** after294.33s. The original15-second/1.5-owned-second timing test failed; three eligible host updates produced exactly.1715008286ownedseconds. The unchanged later motion check also failed because tail movement was3.75e-11m, below its1e-8m threshold (head1.20µm). Four annotated hoof patches and source bones remained fixed. All other collected product checks passed: source-clock accounting, framing/budgets, reduced-motion/confidence-hidden pause, actual selection/corrected card, and disposal. All four desktop PNGs were reviewed. Browser/server cleanup completed with no active owned process and zero browser errors. No source, camera, threshold, deadline change or retry occurred. This overall desktop failure and all earlier failures remain failures; the separate current mobile pass does not replace them. Live-DEV/updated-person integration and ordinary CI remain outstanding, so keep this PR draft. T-2800/T-2803 remain open: anatomy, eyes, solid mane/tail and the 1K coat remain development limits. No walking, four-leg weight shift, fitted gear, hitching, riding, photographic master, full-ticket completion or merge clearance is claimed.


## Superseded — 2026-10-23

Closed after replacement #1244 merged normally to DEV as fa115d72534e234fe5ac7b94fd2f1a3eb38065c8 with fresh green gate, moving-frame/phone and report checks. Replacement uses a redesigned planted standing clip and consumer; this is supersession, not a claim of byte containment. Historical receipts in this draft remain preserved. T-2800/T-2803 stay open for photographic refinement and full gait/gear/teams/riding acceptance.
